dict.string: When you ask, Pippa reads the email you selected in Mail and the table you’re looking at in Excel, opens Numbers tables you give her to read them, and searches your photos and notes. Nothing is sent without your approval.
When you ask, Pippa reads your appointments for the period you ask about, and adds deadlines from your letters to Calendar, which it can remove again.
When you ask, Pippa looks up addresses and phone numbers in your contacts. She doesn’t change them.
Pippa reads and tidies files on your Desktop when you ask her to. You can undo her changes.
Pippa reads and tidies files in your Documents folder when you ask her to. You can undo her changes.
Pippa reads and tidies files in your Downloads folder when you ask her to. You can undo her changes.
Pippa reads and tidies files in your cloud folders (iCloud Drive, OneDrive, Dropbox, Google Drive) when you ask her to. You can undo her changes.
When you click the microphone, Pippa listens so you can speak instead of typing. What you say becomes text on this Mac and is not sent anywhere.
When you ask for pictures, Pippa shows the matching photos from your library. She doesn’t change or upload anything.
Pippa adds deadlines from your letters to Reminders when you ask, and can remove them again.
Pippa reads and tidies files on your USB sticks and external disks when you ask her to. You can undo her changes.
Pippa turns what you say into text on this Mac when you click the microphone. Nothing is sent to Apple or anyone else.
